integrity: Analytic proof with direct independent finite-system numerical cross-checks (813 comparisons). Existing homogeneous-link parity obstruction and coherent-perfect-absorber mechanism acknowledged. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary monochromatic scattering at band-center energy E=0 on one semi-infinite lead coupled to a finite uniform-loss segment, with real positive hopping; no claim of broadband absorption, disorder robustness, general Lindblad dynamics, or global literature priority.
title: A tunable-link parity bifurcation for exact absorption in finite lossy quantum chains
